article_title: Why Gen Z are opting out of workplace pensions

tasks.prompt: What central tension does the article explore?
options: Young workers balancing immediate living costs against long-term pension security
Employers replacing workplace pensions with state pensions
Retirees choosing whether to return to full-time work
The NHS ending employer pension contributions
tasks.correct_answer: Young workers balancing immediate living costs against long-term pension security
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת בצעירים שמוותרים זמנית על חיסכון לפנסיה כדי להתמודד עם הוצאות מיידיות, למרות המחיר העתידי.

tasks.prompt: Why did Hassan Nassar pause his NHS pension contributions?
options: He planned to retire outside the UK.
He had become self-employed.
He needed money for family care, housing and current repayments.
The NHS stopped contributing to his pension.
tasks.correct_answer: He needed money for family care, housing and current repayments.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חסן ציין טיפול בבן משפחה חולה, חיסכון לבית, שכר דירה והחזרי הלוואת סטודנטים.

tasks.prompt: What does “compound” mean in the article’s discussion of pension growth?
options: To lock money away without any return
To grow through returns added to earlier savings and returns
To combine a state pension with rent payments
To reduce the employer’s minimum contribution
tasks.correct_answer: To grow through returns added to earlier savings and returns
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ריבית דריבית היא צמיחה שבה התשואה מצטרפת לחיסכון וגם היא ממשיכה לצבור תשואה לאורך זמן.

tasks.prompt: Which change did DWP data show for eligible 22-to-29-year-olds who had recently started a job?
options: Their opt-out rate fell from 11.5% to 6.6%.
Their pension age rose from 57 to 60.
Their minimum contribution doubled to 10%.
Their opt-out rate rose from 6.6% to 11.5%.
tasks.correct_answer: Their opt-out rate rose from 6.6% to 11.5%.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנתונים השוו את שלושת החודשים עד דצמבר: 6.6% בשנת 2020 לעומת 11.5% בשנה האחרונה.

tasks.prompt: Why is opting out especially costly for a worker in their twenties, according to April Leeson?
options: They lose employer contributions and decades of compound growth.
They permanently lose eligibility for the state pension.
They must immediately repay all earlier tax relief.
They cannot rejoin a workplace scheme later.
tasks.correct_answer: They lose employer contributions and decades of compound growth.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: היא מדגישה גם את כסף המעסיק שנאבד וגם את הזמן הארוך שבו החיסכון המוקדם יכול לצמוח בריבית דריבית.

tasks.prompt: In Evie’s situation, what does “impractical” mean?
options: Legally forbidden by her employer
Guaranteed to produce a loss
Difficult to do given her current expenses and goals
Suitable only for workers over 30
tasks.correct_answer: Difficult to do given her current expenses and goals
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עבור אווי, הפרשה לפנסיה אינה מעשית כרגע בגלל שכר דירה, מזון, נסיעות ויעדים כמו בית ורכב.

tasks.prompt: State the normal age and earnings conditions for automatic workplace-pension enrolment described in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין גיל 22 ומעלה והכנסה מעל 10,000 ליש״ט, תוך הכרה בכך שיש חריגים.
expected_points: The worker is normally aged 22 or above.
The worker normally earns more than £10,000, although exceptions exist.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Hassan’s short-term decision and its possible long-term cost.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את ההפסקה הזמנית בשל לחץ תזרימי ואת אובדן החיסכון והריבית העתידית שהוערכו ב־5,000–10,000 ליש״ט.
expected_points: He paused contributions for roughly six to twelve months to meet immediate financial needs.
He estimates the missed saving and compound growth could reduce retirement income by £5,000 to £10,000.

tasks.prompt: How do Evie’s and Kharlee’s experiences support the pensions minister’s warning?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין לחצי ההווה והפסקת ההפרשות לבין חיסכון פרטי נמוך יותר וחשש מפרישה לא נוחה בעתיד.
expected_points: Evie prioritises present housing and living costs over pension saving.
Kharlee believes repeated pauses cost about £5,000 and now worries about retirement security.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced paragraph advising a young worker who is considering opting out, using evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הפסקה צריכה להכיר בלחץ יוקר המחיה אך גם להסביר אובדן תרומת מעסיק וריבית דריבית; אפשר להציע הפחתת הפרשה אם המעסיק מאפשר.
expected_points: Acknowledge immediate pressures such as rent, debt, family care or saving for housing.
Explain the value of employer contributions and long-term compound growth.
Mention reducing contributions or returning to the scheme as possible alternatives when available.
